question: What Is the Difference Between Fail Open, Fail Closed and Fail Locked Valves?
body_html:
A fail safe valve position is the position a control valve moves to when it loses its control signal, instrument air or actuator power. It is chosen from the process hazard analysis and shown on the P&ID.

PositionOn loss of air or signalActuator actionExample
FO, fail openGoes fully openATC, air to closeCooling water valve
FC, fail closedGoes fully closedATO, air to openFuel gas valve
FL, fail lockedStays at last positionLock up relay neededHold position duties
